newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26): no change to the Rs 6,000/year amount or the eligibility rules in 2025-2026. The Cabinet continued the scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31 (PIB 31 Jul 2026, already cited). Changes reported are operational: e-KYC, Farmer ID in some states, and Aadhaar-bank seeding.

findings.note: Guideline §5.2 sets 01.02.2019 as the land-ownership cut-off (except inheritance). Neither the rules nor the content mention it, so someone who bought land after 2019 gets 'likely eligible'. (PM-KMY's content does mention its own cut-off date.)
findings.suggestion: Add one sentence to how_to_apply: 'Land bought after 1 February 2019 does not count, except land inherited after a death.' A rule is not possible with the current fields.

findings.note: Guideline §5.1 makes an exception to the land-records requirement for the North-East states and Jharkhand (community land, etc.). With 'confirmed', a 'no' there gives 'not eligible'.
findings.suggestion: Mention the North-East/Jharkhand exception in how_to_apply, or accept it as a known limit.

findings.note: The quote covers serving or retired employees (4.1(b)(iii)) but not the Rs 10,000 pension clause (iv), which the field question and rule text include. The logic is right; the quote is partial.
findings.suggestion: Optionally extend the quote or the locator to cover (iv).
